problem: Repository changes lack a declared, executable contract for scope, boundaries, proportional verification, and reusable evidence.
non_goals: Do not add a governance service, database, or third-party runtime dependency.
Do not create CODEOWNERS before a real remote and OWNER identity are verified.
Do not retroactively block untouched historical debt.

capabilities: modify repository files in a proposed change

success_criteria.description: Paths outside the declared task scope are rejected.
Approvals are scoped to their immutable task contract and are not trusted locally without platform OWNER enforcement.
Untouched historical-baseline debt does not block unrelated work; touched debt requires a disposition.
Verification selects proportional fixed gates and reuses green evidence for the same tree, task card, and gate.
The governance tool adds no third-party governance dependency.

stop_conditions: No unresolved Critical or Important finding remains.
One implementer self-review and one independent review are complete.
Candidate verification meets the declared plan.
